headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: Study links energy drinks to risk of cardiac arrest
headlines.description: New research presented at the American Heart Association’s annual meeting found that cardiac arrest was higher among those who consumed energy drinks and supplements. NBC News’ Berkeley Lovelace Jr. explains which types of stimulants to watch out for.

headlines.title: Get Your Steps in This Fall With Start TODAY’s November Plan
headlines.description: Kick off November with Start TODAY’s plan for building a walking streak over the next 75 days. Fitness contributor Stephanie Mansour and nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer serve up motivation and healthy recipes to help you reach your goal.

headlines.title: Flu Season Kicks off Early: Is it Too Late to Get the Vaccine?
headlines.description: Flu activity is higher than usual for this time of year, according to the CDC, so NBC News medical contributor, Dr. Akshay Syal, joins TODAY with tips to stay healthy. He discusses why there’s an early uptick in numbers, how to protect against the strain that is circulating, and how to manage your symptoms if you do get the flu.

headlines.title: How Healthy Habits in Middle Age May Ward Off Alzheimer’s
headlines.description: New research is focusing largely on what younger people can do to potentially ward off Alzheimer’s disease. Studies show that healthy habits early on, including sleep, diet and exercise, may boost brain health long-term and possibly slam the breaks on cognitive decline. NBC’s Kate Snow reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Michaels, Home Depot and Birch Lane all have Christmas trees on sale this week for up to 50% off
headlines.description: Retailers are already discounting prelit Christmas trees for the holidays — save up to 50% on trees from Home Depot, Michael’s, Birch Lane and more.

headlines.title: How to insulate your home to keep it warm during the winter, according to experts
headlines.description: I spoke to multiple home experts to learn how to keep your home warm and insulated when the temperature drops, and the best hands-on tools to use.

headlines.title: These 9 travel pill cases will make you ditch the sandwich bags for good
headlines.description: These travel pill cases can help you keep prescription medications, vitamins and supplements organized and easy to access while at home or traveling.

headlines.title: This Shark vacuum is 50% off — and no, that’s not a typo
headlines.description: The Shark Stratos Upright is 50% off at Amazon. One owner of three dogs and two cats calls it the first vacuum that has kept their floors clean.

headlines.title: Dietitian Reveals the Healthiest Type of Canned Tuna
headlines.description: Canned tuna is a quick source of protein, but which type is best for you? A dietitian reveals what to look for in healthier canned tuna and which types to limit.

headlines.title: Dietitian Shares Her Favorite High-Protein Food to Balance Blood Sugar
headlines.description: You can use food to manage blood sugar spikes and keep your energy steady throughout the day. A dietitian recommends one high-protein and high-fiber food to help.

headlines.title: At 58, I Had Early Signs of Alzheimer’s in My Brain. These Interventions Got Rid of Them
headlines.description: In the months leading up to my mother’s 75th birthday in June 2019, I was planning a surprise party.
